item.title: For checkpoint and settler attack news, Palestinians tune into the radio

item.description: The rapper also challenged Robert Kraft to match the donation as fallout from his removal from Ed Sheeran’s tour grows.

item.title: Manchester United lose 3-2 to Brighton, crash out of League Cup
item.description: Brighton come from two goals down to win 3-2 at Old Trafford, to shock Manchester United as slow start continues.

item.description: Rescue workers search for survivors after Gaza building collapse

item.title: US removes Venezuela from drug list, Trump says
item.description: Trump says the country has made progress against narcotics since Maduro's removal, may also remove Colombia and Bolivia.

item.title: Displaced Syrians dig through hills of garbage to make a living
item.description: Displaced Syrians are digging through mountains of burning garbage searching for recyclable materials to make a living.

item.title: New video claims to show Saudi fighter jet Houthis say they shot down
item.description: Houthi forces have released a video claiming to show a Saudi fighter jet the group says was shot down in Yemen’s Marib.

item.title: Syria abolishes al-Assad-era ‘terrorism’ court as Kurdish tensions flare
item.description: Discontent is testing President Ahmed al-Sharaa's ability to unify a country emerging from 14 years of conflict.

item.title: Efforts underway for Zelenskyy-Trump meeting at UN next week
item.description: Trump pushes for a solution to end Moscow's war against Kyiv as civilian deaths in Ukraine rise.

item.title: Al-Mughayyir: A village under siege
item.description: In al-Mughayyir, Palestinians say they are being squeezed into a smaller part of their own village in the West Bank.

item.title: Republican US senator slams Trump vaccine policy amid rising measles deaths
item.description: US Senator Bill Cassidy presses Trump's pick for surgeon general on views over vaccines, public health.

item.title: Lebanon returns 37 artefacts smuggled out of Egypt six years ago
item.description: The artefacts date back to the pharaonic civilisation, more commonly referred to as ancient Egypt.

item.title: Jerusalem Daily: US to send $2.8BN worth of weapons to Israel
item.description: A 15-year-old boy was killed in a double-tap strike while trying to save a paramedic.

item.title: US Fed raises interest rates for first time in three years
item.description: The 25 basis-point hike is the first raise in three years and comes before critical midterm elections in the US.

item.title: Geopolitical divides fueling UN Security Council inaction, Guterres warns
item.description: Guterres calls for urgent Security Council reform, says geopolitical divides hindering action on global crises.

item.title: UK trade unions back motion to boycott and sanction Israel
item.description: Motion demands taking action to oppose the 'catastrophic destruction of Gaza' and Israeli settler violence.

item.title: Belarus frees 25 political prisoners in return for US sanctions relief
item.description: The Trump administration said more releases would be secured soon amid improved US-Belarus relations.

item.title: Kosovo’s former president guilty of war crimes
item.description: Hashim Thaci, former President of Kosovo and KLA leader, has been found guilty of war crimes in the Hague.

item.title: Why has the response to Nepal’s floods been so muted?
item.description: Because wealthy nations do not want to take responsibility for their role in the current climate crisis.

item.title: South Africa slams planned US visa curbs over alleged racial discrimination
item.description: Trump administration falling for misinformation from 'fringe groups' alleging discrimination against white Afrikaners.

item.title: ‘Nowhere to go’: Gaza’s damaged buildings turn deadly
item.description: A war-damaged building collapses in Gaza City, killing at least 21 Palestinians and exposing fears of unsafe ruins.

item.title: Neturei Karta: Opposing Zionism
item.description: Inside Neturei Karta, the ultra-Orthodox Jewish group that rejects Zionism, supports Palestinians fighting occupation.

item.title: Can the US government punish a university for boycotting Israel?
item.description: The US House passed a bill that could cut universities off from federal student aid if they boycott Israel.

item.title: Poll shows Americans are increasingly alarmed by AI’s ecological footprint
item.description: New poll finds over half of Americans fear AI-driven data centers will hike electricity costs and strain water supplies.

item.title: Malaysia offers to invite Myanmar leader in Rohingya repatriation push
item.description: Malaysia has invited Myanmar’s military ruler for a visit to the country in a bid to expedite Rohingya repatriation.
